title.en: A file baked into a layer

hints.en: The `RUN` line is ready in the comment; `CMD ["cat", "/built.txt"]`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM alpine:3.22
RUN echo "made at build time" > /built.txt
CMD ["cat", "/built.txt"]
```
